external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Carlton Senior Living, a senior and assisted living operator in northern California, partnered with software company Speak2 to implement Alexa-enabled devices to increase communication between residents, families and staff and improve staffing efficiencies. Speak2 helped Carlton set up Alexa voice-enabled technology so that residents and staff can have conversations in real-time without opening an app or sitting at a computer.
